title: Aggrega Path-Template Context
description: The variable allowlist consumed by Go templates evaluated against Release.spec.boundaries[].directory and Release.spec.boundaries[].subDirectory (and the per-component subDirectory override) when Aggrega builds the Release. Path templates use missingkey=error (distinct from the global missingkey=zero regime for value templates) plus parse-time validation: every field reference in a path template must appear in this allowlist for the relevant context (directory: vs subDirectory:); unknown fields produce a Loud Guardrail error at parse time, never at render time. The Path-Template Variables page of the language reference teaches the difference from value templates.

capability.description: Available in directory: AND subDirectory:. The rendering capability the contributing component's Recipe declares in spec.capability, with any version pin stripped — for example 'helm', 'helm-chart' or 'compose'. subDirectory: defaults to {{ .capability }}, which is what lands each capability's artifacts in their own sub-folder beneath the boundary's directory. In a directory: template the value is resolved per-component, so a boundary whose subtree contributes more than one capability evaluates to one directory per capability; the separate per-boundary walk that publishes .parent_boundary.directory runs before any component is bound and leaves this value empty.

boundary_name.description: Available in directory: AND subDirectory:. The map key in release.spec.boundaries.<key>.

parameters.description: Available in directory: AND subDirectory:. Typed parameter map from the Release. Path templates receive .parameters access as a deliberate carve-out from the parameters single-pass lifecycle — value templates do NOT receive .parameters; environment-shaped values flow into value templates via the already-interpolated Aggregate YAML.

component_id.description: Available in subDirectory: ONLY. The identity of the contributor being placed. For a component, its flattened per-component instance ID (e.g., 'backend' or 'data-layer.main-db'). For a Feature attached at a boundary whose FeatureRecipe runs once for the boundary (executionScope: boundary), the composed component identity every resource that attachment emits carries in its aggrega.ai/component-id label (e.g., 'bfr--app--shared' for an attachment 'shared' at boundary 'app'), shortened where the attachment's rendering plugin bounds names, so the directory it names matches that label. Meaningless at boundary-level and rejected by parse-time validation in directory: templates.

parent_boundary.description: Available in directory: AND subDirectory:. The parent boundary's already-resolved values. Populated via depth-first walk evaluating each boundary's templates with its parent's resolved values; children never see their own values here. A top-level boundary has no parent, so a key read under parent_boundary there halts the build, naming the boundary, the template field and the missing key.

boundary_name.description: Parent's name (the map key in release.spec.boundaries).

parameters.description: The Release's parameter map — the same map .parameters carries.

annotations.description: The parent boundary's annotations after the cascade resolves.

manifest.description: Available in directory: AND subDirectory:. Carries the resolved Recipe metadata as evaluated per-component.

recipe_name.description: The resolved Recipe's name from the per-component lookup.
